note: Each metric has a physical definition, normalization, and formula. Values are ceilings/tolerances, not targets. Headroom over gold-run observations accounts for MPI domain-decomposition noise (2 ranks) without weakening the physics.

particle_count_conservation.definition: Macro-particle count per species must not change between first and last particle snapshot.

ux_drift_relative_change.definition: Weight-averaged streaming four-velocity ux per species stays at the initialized drift (0.2 c).
ux_drift_relative_change.formula: abs(mean_ux(t_last) - 0.2) / 0.2 <= tolerance, mean over all macro-particles of the species at the last snapshot

b1_mean_absolute_deviation.definition: Domain-averaged B1 keeps the imposed uniform background (normalized units, larmor0 = 1).
b1_mean_absolute_deviation.formula: abs(mean(B1)(t) - 1.0) <= tolerance for every field snapshot

b1_squared_relative_drift.definition: Magnetic energy proxy <B1^2> does not drift over the run.
b1_squared_relative_drift.formula: abs(<B1^2>(t) - <B1^2>(t0)) / <B1^2>(t0) <= tolerance for every stats row

e_squared_noise_ceiling.definition: Transverse/total electric energy stays at particle-noise level: no streaming-instability growth.
e_squared_noise_ceiling.formula: max over stats rows of (<E1^2> + <E2^2> + <E3^2>) <= ceiling (code-normalized energy density)
e_squared_noise_ceiling.gold_observation: <= ~1e-6 for the whole run; 100x headroom allowed for 2-rank MPI noise

energy_relative_drift.definition: Total energy (T00 / stats total) conserved within discretization error.
energy_relative_drift.formula: abs(E_tot(t) - E_tot(t0)) / E_tot(t0) <= tolerance for every stats row

stats_time_monotonic.definition: Stats time column strictly increases and contains no NaN/Inf (output sanity).
